about: Battery: why your phone battery wears out. Viewer-as-subject puzzle film: your phone battery is already shrinking, check your own Battery health in Settings. The twist: sitting at 100% ages it faster (Samsung, Apple, Google docs; Battery University estimate: a year full at 77°F keeps about 80%, at 40% about 96%). Heat and deep drains add wear, which is why iPhone, Pixel and Samsung now let you stop at 80%. Ends asking for the viewer's battery health number. Factory #7. Narration-led: the voice is recorded first and every visual beat is keyed to its word times.

lines.text: Your phone battery is already shrinking.
Check your battery health in the Settings app.
Below 100%? So why does it drop?
lines.say: Below a hundred percent? So why does it drop?

lines.text: Here's the twist: sitting at 100% ages it faster.
lines.say: Here's the twist. Sitting at a hundred percent ages it faster.

lines.text: Leave a battery full for a year at room temp.
lines.say: Leave a battery full, for a year, at room temp.

lines.text: It keeps about 80% of its capacity.
lines.say: It keeps about eighty percent of its capacity.
Leave it at forty percent instead? About ninety-six.

lines.text: And heat over 95°F can do permanent damage.
lines.say: And heat over 95 degrees can do permanent damage.

lines.text: Draining it to zero wears it too.
That's why iPhone, Pixel and Samsung let you stop at 80%.
lines.say: That's why iPhone, Pixel and Samsung let you stop at eighty percent.

lines.text: Charging overnight? Your phone can wait at 80 until you wake.
lines.say: Charging overnight? Your phone can wait at eighty until you wake.
